Exact name match, same meaning in both vocabularies.

The old vocabulary's FUNCTIONAL is a subject-matter class with no direct counterpart; the new vocabulary instead distinguishes by origin (CODE/API/CONTRACT). Which one applies depends on the specific requirement instance and cannot be decided at the class level -- each old FUNCTIONAL requirement must be re-examined against its actual source.

Same problem as FUNCTIONAL: NON_FUNCTIONAL has no new-vocabulary counterpart and could land in OPERATIONS, RUNTIME_BEHAVIOR, or CONFIG depending on the specific requirement; requires per-instance re-examination.
The old value bundles three concerns the new vocabulary keeps separate (SECURITY, PRIVACY, and POLICY for legal/regulatory). Each old instance must be split by re-reading its actual content.
The new vocabulary keeps ARCHITECTURE and DATA as two separate values; the old bundled value must be split per-instance.

The new vocabulary has RUNTIME_BEHAVIOR but no single DEPLOYMENT value; deployment-related old instances likely split across OPERATIONS/CONFIG depending on content. Requires per-instance re-examination.
The new vocabulary keeps OPERATIONS and FAILURE_RECOVERY as two separate values; the old bundled value must be split per-instance.

11_CONTRACT_UPGRADE_BLUEPRINT.md SS6.2's 15-value vocabulary has no AI-specific source class at all. This is a real vocabulary gap, not a naming difference -- old AI_AGENT_MODEL requirements have no destination class until a design authority either adds one or specifies which existing value (likely CODE, API, or a new value) should absorb them. Logged as a design-change-queue follow-up rather than guessed here.

INFERRED is not actually a subject-matter/origin class -- it describes HOW a requirement was found, which both schemas already track separately via discovery_methods (ARCHITECTURE_INFERENCE). Its presence in the old source_classes enum conflates the source-class axis with the discovery-method axis, the same category of mistake DCQ-0002 diagnosed at the higher (Product-Design-vs-Target-Assurance) level. No new-vocabulary source_class value should absorb it; old instances tagged INFERRED should be re-examined and re-tagged with discovery_methods=ARCHITECTURE_INFERENCE plus whatever real source_class actually applies.
